messages:
emma.k: heads up — after the RBAC refactor merged into staging at ~08:12 we observed svc-infra-shared listing and reading objects from several customer-project buckets. tagging @soledad.

raj.p: can you paste the audit snippet? any deploy id or commit?

samir.sre: paste the minimal audit entry I grabbed from stackdriver — looks like `storage.objects.get` from that service account: 
```
protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.get"
resourceName="projects/_/buckets/customer-prod-123/objects/alerts.log"
principalEmail="svc-infra-shared@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
authInfo.principalSubject="serviceAccount:svc-infra-shared@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

samir.sre: also noticed a `projects/*/keys/` KMS decrypt entry timestamped a minute earlier — opening KMS logs now.

soledad.l: if KMS decrypts happened we need to treat as potential key exposure. do we have any data exfil alerts?

emma.k: no exfil alerts so far from DLP, but access pattern is suspicious (read of multiple buckets in <2m). marking as P1 for now.

raj.p: traced to commit 98a2f7b — refactor of workspace->project mapping. fallback behavior now returns `global-infra` when mapping not found. that looks like it inadvertently granted `infra:reader` on projects without explicit isolation.

samir.sre: reproduced locally: mapping entry absent -> code calls `resolve_workspace_owner()` -> returns null -> checks `if (!owner) return GLOBAL_INFRA_ROLE;` and then applies role to service account. pushing a quick patch to return 403 instead.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by raj.p for revert patch (ci/job/5234). ETA ~ 10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

soledad.l: action list: 1) revoke short-term tokens for svc-infra-shared (samir) 2) rotate service account keys if any (emma) 3) block global fallback in prod config (raj) 4) run audit query for last 24h for that SA across all projects (soledad) 5) notify customer success/legal if any customer data touched (emma)

samir.sre: revoked tokens and deleted ephemeral key. rotating long-lived keys next and will post confirmation.

emma.k: opening incident channel #inc-212345 — will draft initial incident summary and timeline. assigning follow-ups in the channel.

raj.p: rolled back mapping change in staging, adding a test to ensure explicit mapping required. will prepare hotfix for prod after infra-approved revert.

soledad.l: good. once we have KMS audit and full list of accessed objects we'll decide customer notification. keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:
